concerns.text: The processed dataset schema in `data-model.md` lists a required property `genre_proportions`, while the contract `contracts/processed_dataset.schema.yaml` (and the implementation plan) use `genre_ilr`. This naming mismatch creates ambiguity about the actual field name produced by the pipeline.

The contracts directory includes `results.schema.yaml` (defining a `coefficient_deltas.csv` artifact), but the plan never mentions generating or validating this artifact. Either the plan should incorporate this step or the contract should be removed if unused.
